g.text: F Value size: full-payload checksum scan

g.text: memtable-bench | Key / prefix / value sensitivity | 1,000,000 stored versions
3 repeats: median and Q1-Q3. Uniform hits, random inserts; precomputed logical keys.
NUMA node 0; shared Xeon server, Turbo enabled. ART/HOT include nibble codec; HOT uses a coarse RW lock.
Cursor scans consume key size/first byte; full scans hash all bytes. No disk I/O. Values remain stored in all cases.
